rows.en: The UCE main force seems to have located the Poseidal Army unit that stole the E2.
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?

rows.en: We will join this operation too, as <mk(-25,75,0,0)><ar(0,0,0)>a pursuit unit. Everyone, stay sharp out there.
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?

rows.en: But to think the brass hid something like that... It seems they don't trust us.
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?

rows.en: But we have no time to argue about that. Right now, carrying out the mission comes first.
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?

rows.en: <cs(1)>White Fang<ce()>'s attack threw off our plans. This is a heavy blow...
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?

rows.en: Our agents who made it back report that one E2 has fallen into White Fang's hands.
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?

rows.en: What they're after is unknown... but clearly another E2 has gone to another faction.
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?

rows.en: Four E2s remain unrecovered. We've lost track of Poseidal too; things are getting worse.
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?

rows.en: In effect we're back to square one, but don't lose heart. We'll continue the pursuit.
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?

rows.en: White Fang... I will meet them again, without fail, and learn what they truly intend...
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?

rows.en: The enemy won't wait for us. Always judge the situation and respond flexibly.
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?
